decisions.reason: Multiple releases and a dedicated page have created substantial sunk costs and public commitment, so the firm remains committed despite any uncertainty.
As the publicly announced flagship product line central to the firm's strategic direction, withdrawal is virtually inconceivable under escalation of commitment.
A dedicated product page signals visible investment and commitment, and accumulated sunk costs make persistence more likely than withdrawal.
Its own page and continued presence reflect public commitment and prior investments, so the firm is likely to continue the product.
